properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-19 after the owner flagged missing coverage in this area on review, prompting a closer satellite-imagery check that the prior block-by-block pass had not actually done for every block despite its own description: MB360, a residential complex marketed under one name but built as two separated volumes -- 701 China Basin St (already tracked as 'MB360', mission_bay_mb360.geojson) and this one at 1200 4th St, ~180m apart. Both addresses are used interchangeably for 'MB360' across apartment-listing sites (apartments.com uses 701 China Basin St; Trulia/Redfin/Zillow use 1200 4th St), consistent with one development having two street-facing volumes rather than being two different buildings. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: correction of the address-attribution sentence: the cited Trulia and Redfin listings are not apartments.com or Zillow and were not shown to mention 701 China Basin St, so the attribution to those sites is withdrawn. That MB360 is one two-block development is supported instead by Ignition Architecture's project page ('Mission Bay, Blocks 5/11'; 362 units in total; owner Essex Property Trust, formerly BRE); the 701 China Basin St address for the other block is from DataSF's Assessor roll (parcel 8710009). 2026-10-02: public-text pass. notes reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- notes: 'Treated as a second volume of the same MB360 development as mission_bay_mb360.geojson (701 China Basin St) rather than a wholly separate project, per apartment-listing sources using both addresses for one marketed community; the two-block development is supported by Ignition Architecture's project page ('Mission Bay, Blocks 5/11'), which is not a developer source. This footprint originally overlapped the adjacent Mission Bay Kids' Park by 69 sq m; trimmed to the non-overlapping remainder.'. REPLACED 2026-10-12 (shape; status and use unchanged): the owner approved building records whose outline matches an Assessor lot at 85% or better, both ways, using the lot (CLAUDE.md, 'An official parcel beats our drawing'). DataSF's Assessor layer (data/raw/parcels.geojson) has Assessor lot 8711017 (7,383 m2, active, mapped 2006-05-22); the earlier outline of 6,992 m2 and the lot overlap with IoU 0.87 (96% of the earlier outline lies inside the lot and it covers 91% of the lot). The outline is now that lot using the lots' own vertices (no simplification). geometry_type stays 'real'.
